Container.Name: fieldwork
Container.Overview: Chess review and practice with bundled Stockfish and one persistent database. Local use needs no login: choose storage and a port, then open WebUI. For separate accounts, set Public origin to your HTTPS address and change the Advanced View WebUI shortcut to that address. Cloudflare and Compose are optional. Engine options are in advanced settings.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: LAN port for the app. Open WebUI follows this mapping automatically. Proxies forward HTTP to this host port.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Persistent games, accounts and progress. Keep when updating. Must be writable by UID 99 and GID 100, configured in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: Public origin
Config.Description: Optional. Blank means one local workspace with no login. For accounts enter the exact browser address, e.g. https://chess.example.com, without a path. Also change WebUI in Advanced View to that address. Restart after changing. Named accounts stay private in local mode.

Config.Name: Account support
Config.Description: Enables accounts when Public origin is set. Blank Public origin always selects local no-login mode. Normally leave true.

Config.Name: Secure session cookies
Config.Description: Keep true for HTTPS accounts. Set false only for intentional trusted-LAN HTTP accounts. Unused in no-login mode.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy addresses
Config.Description: Account mode behind a reverse proxy: the proxy address whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted, so sign-in rate limits apply per visitor instead of to everyone behind the proxy. Use the proxy container's address, or * on a private Docker network.

Config.Name: Shared engine slots
Config.Description: Account mode: maximum simultaneous engines and analysis jobs shared by all users. One additional worker fetches games without analysis. Worker count does not grow with accounts. Busy searches wait. Slots times Threads is the native search-thread budget. Local mode uses separate job and interactive engines.

Config.Name: Threads per engine
Config.Description: CPU search threads per Stockfish instance, not a Docker CPU limit. More threads work on the same position. Budget concurrent engines times threads against your allocated CPUs.

Config.Name: Hash memory per engine (MB)
Config.Description: RAM for each engine's temporary position table. Four engines at 64 MB need about 256 MB plus app and engine overhead. Not disk storage or a database limit.

Config.Name: Analysis workers
Config.Description: Concurrent moves per game review (1 to 16). More workers speed up each game's analysis using available CPUs. Reviews also obey Shared engine slots, so raise both together. Every saved game is analyzed automatically; opening a game moves it to the front of the queue.

Config.Name: Human move insights
Config.Description: Optional Maia-3 human move policy alongside Stockfish. Requires explicit model setup in the container console: python -m trainer.human_models.setup. Normal reviews never download weights. Stockfish review works without it. About 0.85 GB extra RAM per loaded worker; no GPU required.

Config.Name: Human model device
Config.Description: cpu (default) runs Maia on the processor and downloads nothing extra. cuda runs it on an NVIDIA GPU: install the Nvidia Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters and set NVIDIA visible devices below. The first start with cuda downloads CUDA PyTorch (about 3 GB, 6.4 GB on disk) into App data/runtime; later starts reuse it.

Config.Name: NVIDIA visible devices
Config.Description: Only for Human model device cuda with --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters. Paste the GPU UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page (GPU-...), or all. Leave blank for CPU.

Config.Name: NVIDIA driver capabilities
Config.Description: Only used with --runtime=nvidia. compute lets PyTorch run on the GPU; utility adds nvidia-smi. Normally leave as is.

Config.Name: Human model file
Config.Description: Persistent pinned Maia-3 79M checkpoint, approximately 316 MB. The setup command downloads and verifies it here. Kept outside the image and database; survives container updates.

Config.Name: Human model threads
Config.Description: CPU inference threads per Maia worker (1 to 16), separate from Stockfish threads. Two is the measured CPU baseline. Budget both engines against assigned CPUs.

Config.Name: Human model workers
Config.Description: Host-wide resident Maia processes (1 to 4), shared across accounts. Each loaded worker needs about 0.85 GB RAM. One serves a small community without copying the model per account.

Config.Name: Human model timeout
Config.Description: Maximum seconds waiting for a model slot and inference (1 to 120). Failed or cancelled workers are terminated; Stockfish evidence is retained.

Config.Name: Refinement positions
Config.Description: Extra investigations per completed baseline game, 0 to 128. Zero disables extra work and retains the normal deep review. The default investigates at most 8 critical or uncertain positions.

Config.Name: Refinement searches per position
Config.Description: Total extra Stockfish searches per nominated position, 2 to 8. Includes root, played move, sacrifice acceptance and optional human alternative comparisons. Completed searches are saved and reused on resume.

Config.Name: Refinement depth
Config.Description: Extra search depth, 1 to 50. Search stops at its time or depth limit. The effective profile never lowers the original baseline search depth or time.

Config.Name: Refinement search seconds
Config.Description: Time per extra search, greater than 0 up to 10 seconds, floored at the baseline search time. Default 8 positions times 4 searches times 2 seconds is at most 64 seconds of native search plus overhead per game. Shares existing engine slots; pause cancels active extra searches.

Config.Name: Refinement candidate moves
Config.Description: Candidate roots for only-move, sacrifice and human-policy disagreements, 2 to 8. Ordinary severity checks use 2 roots. More candidates divide the search budget; a shallower result cannot replace the baseline.
